systems.owner: proposed by a University of Johannesburg researcher; not deployed
systems.tiers: proposed for traditional authority offices in rural areas; fieldwork in Vhembe District Municipality, Limpopo

note: A proposed model for traditional authority offices, which are not municipalities: 62.5% of 112 survey respondents in Vhembe said digital services had not been introduced in those offices, with inadequate internet connectivity named as a challenge. Nothing on a municipal office's own connection.
